scope: PC code and state tests only; no rendered-browser verification

checks.name: Four tiers use approved 5 / 10 / 20 / 100 prices and distinct new artwork
Isolated preview survives page initialization without writing real localStorage
Shipping 900 + handling 200 + tax 100 cents equals exactly 1200 cents
Explicit zero tax is accepted; missing, null, fractional and negative tax are rejected
Shipping quote updates Tax, Total and CTA together
Shipping charges $12 once, persists each fee and ignores a repeated click
Changing the address invalidates the old quote and does not debit balance
Incomplete API quote cannot be paid; retry label and fee error are shown
Closing shipping ignores a late quote response
Insufficient balance requests the exact shortfall without shipping or debiting
One-time storage failure rolls back in-memory shipment and persisted balance
Pending to ready keeps the same opening ID and never touches balance
Ended / skip duplicate checks share one in-flight result lookup
Confirmed failed and pool updating produce separate states; ready can follow an updated pool
Network, empty product and wrong opening ID never become an empty prize success
Timeout and closing both reject a late ready response
Resolved result is not re-fetched or re-opened
Same 16:9 artboard fits 1280×800, 1440×900 and 1920×1080 without exceeding available viewport
Original seven prize-pool products, prices and odds remain unchanged; free swap is absent
